verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Letta integrating with Codex, Claude Code, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw for skills (docs-57), and offering an OpenAI-compatible API for tools like Open WebUI plus an ACP adapter for Zed (docs-23), but nothing shows Letta connecting to or sharing memory with off-the-shelf Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor specifically. Letta's MCP support is client-side (Letta consuming MCP servers, docs-61/76), and community evidence notes only a third-party 'Letta-MCP-server' built by a user, not an official integration exposing Letta memory to these named assistants.
